'''Kelsara Llenkch''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] in the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A legendary [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], she was reputed for being "the assassin's assassin." At some point before [[23 BBY/Legends|13:2:28]] [[Great ReSynchronization|GRS]], Llenkch was hired by the burgeoning [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]] to kill [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], then [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic. Along with three [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and a [[Yuzzem]], Llenkch infiltrated the [[Naboo Embassy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], which the Chancellor was meant to visit. While some of her associates were posing as [[Chef/Legends|chefs]] in the embassy's kitchens, Llenkch and another man first tried to shoot [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], who was responsible for the building's security. That attempt, and consequently the whole plan, was foiled when [[Security Advisor]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] intervened. Because of Binks' fortunate clumsiness, Llenkch and her men were knocked out when a group of spherical [[sentinel droid]]s fell on their heads. All five mercenaries were put in the custody of the Royal Naboo Security Forces, and Binks was made [[Junior Representative/Legends|Associate Planetary Representative]] for [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].
